sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I'm outside my hotel, heading to the airport.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I find the stop and ask the coach driver.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Hi, does this coach go to the airport?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Yeah, this one's going straight to the airport.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Great, is the pickup point by this shelter?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Usually, yeah, but we've moved it for today.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Oh, I can see a sign on the shelter.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: That's right, it shows today's pickup point.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: It says every twenty minutes, so when's the next one?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: The next one's at ten twenty, and it's on time.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I check where to wait with the driver.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Is the pickup point on this side of the road?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: It's by the hotel curb, just past the red door, not here.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Sorry, which door did you say I should look for?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: The red door, on this side of the road.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Okay, I don't need to cross the road, then.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: That's right, just walk back towards your hotel.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Can I wait inside the shelter until the coach comes?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Better wait by the red door so we see you.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Got it, and how much is the ride today?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: It's twelve pounds, and one suitcase is included.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I check how to pay before heading over.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: The sign says card only, so you don't take cash?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: That's right, you can pay when you get on.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Can I tap my card, or do I need a ticket?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Just tap your card, and I'll give you a ticket.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Thanks, can you help me put my suitcase in?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Of course, I'll put it under the coach for you.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: So I'll wait by the red door for ten twenty.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Exactly, keep your bag beside you while you wait.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Thanks, my card's ready, so I'll head over.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I know where to wait and how to pay.
